skill_name: Write an email given the subject and the task.
workflow:
Dear team, 

I am writing this email to follow up on our meeting earlier today. I want to remind you all of the actions that were agreed upon. First and foremost, we discussed starting our new task force and assigning roles to each member. Please make sure that you have selected your role, and distributed the tasks accordingly. Secondly, we also discussed our timeline for delivering the project. Our deadline is in six weeks, so please ensure that you are on track. Lastly, we discussed budgeting.
